title: Fair Hate Speech Detection through Evaluation of Social Group Counterfactuals

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating counterfactual token fairness in hate speech classifiers by substituting race-related Social Group Tokens (SGTs) and filtering asymmetric counterfactuals using GPT-2 sentence likelihood scores.

Evaluating counterfactual token fairness in hate speech classifiers by substituting religion-related Social Group Tokens (SGTs) (e.g., 'Muslim', 'Jew') and filtering asymmetric counterfactuals using GPT-2 sentence likelihood scores.
